description: This Java class 'AllergyValidator' provides validation logic for Allergy objects within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It ensures the correctness and consistency of allergy data, such as non-null patient and allergen details, preventing duplicate entries, and validating input formats.

classes.name: AllergyValidator
classes.description: A Spring component that validates 'Allergy' objects, ensuring required fields are set, duplicate allergies are avoided, and input formats are correct.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the validator supports the class 'Allergy' or its subclasses.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation on an 'Allergy' object, ensuring it meets all data integrity rules, such as non-null fields, non-numeric reaction descriptions, and no duplicates.
